summary: Kerb among apartment blocks where cars park; homes within 25 m all round.

best_section.where: East kerb of Clarence Road south of the Henry apartments

drivers.seclusion: Dense apartments across the road and a detached house 16 m at the south end; The Henry is 8 m away further north.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb lane with parked cars along the east side; room to pull in where a car already stops.
drivers.traffic: Busy through street with apartments and shops nearby.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; 2P limit applies Monday to Friday daytime only.

flags: Steep: about 7% over the best section, DEM shows up to 30% in spots
Brisbane River 295 m away, ground 20-23 m
sun_shade: Large tree canopy at the south end shades it; apartment blocks shade the west side in the morning.
